title: GodsEater: a fantasy god game where you answer prayers and survive hungry gods (trailer and a demo)
author: SaleBig2814
selftext:
This is the trailer for my first game, GodsEater, a story rich fantasy god game I made in Unity. The story is about that you are a newborn god, you answer prayers, forge angels, and try not to get eaten by the older gods.

How I used AI:

\- Art: the paintings and character sprites started as AI images. Then I fixed and matched them with my own tools (faces, hands, colours), so every character looks the same in all of their expressions, however some assets need polishing which I will do later. 

What's mine: the world, the characters, the story and the game design.

Links: I have post a demo in itch which you can try the game there

 itch.io: [https://twindark.itch.io/godseater](https://twindark.itch.io/godseater)

 Steam: (coming soon)

For the full release, I plan to replace the AI art, voices and music with work by human artists. The AI version lets me build and test the whole game first.

Happy to answer questions about the workflow!

comments.author: Valdaraak
comments.body: I'd recommend changing the name of your game before full release. It's too similar to God Eater, which is the name of a fairly big series of games and Japanese companies will very happily send a C&D/DMCA notice to anything that catches their eye.

replies.author: SaleBig2814
replies.body: ngl, this was the first question in my mind when I named the game, I have tried to come with hundred of games but all of them didn't reflect my game idea, I will try come with something else before the full release tho, Thank you!
